events.title: Byzantine emperor Philippicus is blinded and deposed
events.description: Soldiers sent by George Buraphus, count of the Opsician army, seized and blinded Emperor Philippicus, who had taken power in a coup against Justinian II in 711. He was succeeded by Anastasios II.
events.html: Soldiers sent by George Buraphus, count of the Opsician army, seized and blinded Emperor Philippicus, who had taken power in a coup against Justinian II in 711. He was succeeded by Anastasios II.

events.title: Norway and Novgorod make peace in the Treaty of Novgorod
events.description: The Treaty of Novgorod, a 10-year peace signed in Novgorod, ended decades of border skirmishes between Norway and Novgorod in Finnmark, in the far north. Novgorod had settled its conflict with Sweden in 1323 in the Treaty of Nöteborg.

events.title: The English navy defeats a Spanish fleet at Sesimbra Bay
events.description: In the Anglo-Spanish War, an English force under Richard Leveson and William Monson met Spanish galleys and a carrack at Sesimbra Bay in Portugal, sinking two galleys and capturing the carrack. It was the last expedition Queen Elizabeth I sent to Spain.

events.title: Dutch West India Company receives its charter
events.description: The States General granted the company a trade monopoly in the Americas and West Africa. It founded New Netherland, seized part of Brazil and became a major Atlantic slave trader.

events.title: Lin Zexu begins destroying confiscated opium at Humen
events.description: The Chinese commissioner had over a thousand tonnes of British-traded opium mixed with lime and salt and flushed into the sea. Britain's response led to the First Opium War.
events.html: The Chinese commissioner had over a thousand tonnes of British-traded opium mixed with lime and salt and flushed into the sea. Britain's response led to the First Opium War.

events.title: Union troops rout Confederate forces at Philippi in Virginia
events.description: Union forces routed Confederate troops in and around Philippi, Virginia, in the clash also called the Philippi Races. It was the first organized land action of the American Civil War, though it is generally viewed as a skirmish rather than a battle.

events.title: Luftwaffe bombs Paris
events.description: In Operation Paula, German aircraft struck airfields and factories around Paris, killing some 250 people. Eleven days later German troops entered the city.
events.html: In Operation Paula, German aircraft struck airfields and factories around Paris, killing some 250 people. Eleven days later German troops entered the city.

events.title: Battle of Midway opens with US air attacks
events.description: Bombers from Midway Atoll attacked the approaching Japanese invasion force. The next day US carrier aircraft sank four Japanese carriers, turning the tide of the Pacific war.
events.html: Bombers from Midway Atoll attacked the approaching Japanese invasion force. The next day US carrier aircraft sank four Japanese carriers, turning the tide of the Pacific war.

events.title: Chinese troops move on Tiananmen Square
events.description: On the night of 3 to 4 June, the army forced its way into central Beijing, firing on crowds. Hundreds, possibly thousands, were killed, ending seven weeks of pro-democracy protest.
events.html: On the night of 3 to 4 June, the army forced its way into central Beijing, firing on crowds. Hundreds, possibly thousands, were killed, ending seven weeks of pro-democracy protest.

events.title: Ayatollah Khomeini dies in Tehran
events.description: Ruhollah Khomeini, leader of the 1979 Iranian Revolution and the Islamic Republic's first Supreme Leader, died aged 86. Ali Khamenei succeeded him the next day.

song: French popular song; later the Paris Commune and the European left
A French love song from 1866 about the short season of cherries, later sung as a song of hope for a better world.
